id: card number - ties the front image to the back
name: Name
as printed on the card
language: language of the card: EN / DE / FR / IT / ES / JP ...
variant: Normal, Reverse Holo, Holo, 1st Edition, Promo, Graded
condition: Cardmarket scale: M NM EX GD LP PL PO
grading: empty, or e.g. PSA 9 / BGS 9.5 and the certificate number
copy: which copy of this card this is (formula)
count: how many of this card you own (formula)
location: physical place, worked out from the ID (formula)
status: Scanned / Ready / Listed / Reserved / Sold / Shipped / Keeping

conditions.title: Condition (Cardmarket scale)
conditions.M: Mint - perfect, no room for wear
conditions.NM: Near Mint - minimal flaws; clouding rules out NM
conditions.EX: Excellent - visibly used, but looked after
conditions.LP: Light Played - heavy signs of use
conditions.PL: Played - badly worn, water damage, bends
conditions.PO: Poor - required for altered cards, blackened edges, stamps, ink

lists.note: Location in the inventory follows the box size; language and currency stay as the workbook was created.

overview.title: Cards - overview
overview.note: Recalculated on every cropdeck track run. Do not type here - everything goes into the inventory.
overview.with_duplicates: cards you own more than once
grey: from the scanner or formulas - do not overwrite
red: the name was recognised with doubt - take a quick look

duplicates.title: Cards you own more than once
duplicates.note: Grouped by name, number and variant from the inventory, including your corrections. Every copy is an item of its own with its own condition and listing - the IDs tell you which.
